body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh government has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) worth Rs 25,000 crore with Puch AI to expand artificial intelligence infrastructure and applications in the state. Announcing the development on its official account on X, the company said, “UP Government and Puch AI have entered into a Rs 25,000 crore MoU to position Uttar Pradesh as India’s first AI Pradesh.
